assembly.name: Drivetrain — 4MOTION (Haldex Gen 5)
assembly.description: Haldex Gen 5 AWD. R6's architecture correction: Gen 5 DELETED the accumulator, the serviceable filter AND the pressure-control valve of earlier generations — one centrifugal electro-hydraulic pump (6-piston axial, BLDC) applies the wet clutch directly; motor speed IS the pressure setpoint, and the only filtration is an inlet strainer gauze. Fluid G 060 175 A2, ~850 ml dry / ~650–700 ml refill, ~3 yr/30k service WITH the strainer cleaned every time (VW's book says fluid only — the strainer is why pumps die). See docs/research/R6-haldex.md.

parts.name: Propshaft, front section
parts.description: Front section of the two-piece propshaft from the bevel box, running on the centre support bearing (R6). Flange stretch bolts (N 10329102 / WHT 005 179, 12-point) renew on assembly; flange torques NOT found — the circulating '55 Nm' is an Audi C6 RS6 figure, rejected. Get the real value from erWin group 39.

parts.name: Propshaft centre support bearing
parts.description: Rubber-isolated centre bearing carrying the propshaft's midpoint on the underbody.
knownIssues: Centre-bearing wear → driveline vibration at speed (R6).

parts.name: Propshaft, rear section
parts.description: Rear section ending at the RDU through a 3-bolt rubber FLEX DISC — not a CV joint (R6 correction). Same renew-bolts rule; torques not found.

parts.name: Rear final drive housing
parts.description: Rear drive unit, 0BR525010x family (R6). Service plugs: drain N 910 827 01 (8 mm hex) 32 Nm, fill N 902 818 02 (5 mm hex) 15 Nm — both with new crush washers. Note the rear-diff (bevel gear) side's own plug torque is only ~30 Nm forum-grade, and R12 carries a 19-vs-35 Nm specialist conflict — verify in erWin.

torqueSpec.note: Haldex drain plug (fill 15 Nm), new crush washers (R6)

parts.name: Haldex Gen 5 coupling (wet multi-plate)
parts.description: The Haldex unit itself (0BR525554, also -A): wet multi-plate clutch pack applied by an annular piston — pump pressure in, clamp force out, torque to the rear axle (R6). Clutch disc count and friction spec NOT found.
knownIssues: Works only as well as its oil supply: see the pump/filter service story — fluid change is on a service interval, filter cleaning is owner-wisdom (dossier §4)

parts.name: Haldex charge pump (0CQ598549)
parts.description: The centrifugal electro-hydraulic (CEH) pump — 6-piston axial design on a BLDC motor whose SPEED is the pressure command; Gen 5 has no separate pressure-control valve (R6, BorgWarner primary sources). Part number 0CQ598549 CONFIRMED as the genuine BorgWarner repair kit; seal/bolt kit alone is 0CQ598305. Pump bolts 9.5 Nm, single-use.
knownIssues: THE dominant Gen 5 failure chain (R6): clutch debris clogs the inlet strainer → pump starves → motor dies → rear drive lost. DTCs P16671/P16668/P16666/P16670, C111307. Clean the strainer at every fluid change and the pump lives.

parts.name: Haldex inlet strainer (gauze)
parts.description: R6 CORRECTION: Gen 5 has NO serviceable filter cartridge — the brief's 'filter' is really this inlet strainer gauze on the pump. Held by T10 screws; CLEAN it (don't replace — nothing to buy) at every fluid change, which VW's own schedule fails to mention.
knownIssues: Clogs with clutch-pack debris — step one of the pump-death chain (R6).

parts.name: Haldex controller (AWD ECU)
parts.description: AWD control module J492 — on Gen 5 it is integrated with the unit; 0CQ907554J supersedes -H (R6). Reads yaw/wheel-speed/throttle over CAN and commands the pump motor speed.

parts.name: Rear differential gear set
parts.description: Crown wheel and diff carrier behind the coupling, running in their own GL-5 gear oil — a separate fluid from the Haldex circuit (dossier §4).

parts.name: Rear driveshafts (tripod in / Rzeppa out) ×2
parts.description: Rear driveshafts from the RDU flanges to the hubs. Inner-CV M10 flange bolts: 70 Nm (R12's correction — the 10→40 Nm figure applies to M8 shafts; R6's forum range 60–70 agrees). Outer hub bolt WHT 005 437 (12-point M16×1.5×70): 200 Nm + 180°, single-use — but physically check the bolt first: a ribbed ~10.9 variant exists that takes only 70 Nm + 90° (R6/R12).

torqueSpec.note: Inner-CV M10 flange bolts (R12); hub bolt WHT005437 = 200 Nm + 180°, single-use — verify variant first

parts.name: Front driveshaft, right (long, intermediate bearing)
parts.description: The long right-hand front axle shaft with its intermediate support bearing — the classic unequal-length transverse layout (dossier §4). Runs out to the front-right hub, where the modelled brake corner lives. Inner-CV M10 flange bolts 70 Nm, renew (R12); outer hub bolt shared with the rear corners — WHT005437, 200 Nm + 180°, single-use.

parts.name: Front driveshaft, left (short)
parts.description: The short left-hand front shaft straight off the diff flange. Inner-CV M10 flange bolts 70 Nm, renew (R12); outer hub bolt shared with the rear corners — WHT005437, 200 Nm + 180°, single-use.

parts.name: Propshaft flex disc (rear, 3-bolt)
parts.description: The rubber flex coupling between propshaft rear section and RDU input — R6 resolved this joint as a 3-bolt flex disc, not a CV. Stretch bolts N 10329102 / WHT 005 179 renew on assembly.
knownIssues: Rubber perishes/cracks with age → clunk on throttle reversal, vibration (R6).
